title: The Parcel That Floated Upstream
central_conflict: a parcel seemed to travel upstream against the river current
decisive_choice: an eddy behind the old stone pier carried floating objects backward
resolution: retrieved the parcel from the eddy and marked the hazard for boaters
story_beats: At the snowy meadow, rabbit and fox discovered a parcel seemed to travel upstream against the river current before the library opened, leaving the visiting readers waiting.
Rabbit attempted an immediate fix, but they followed the main channel but could not explain its movement; fox stopped the attempt before the situation worsened.
Fox examined the evidence and realized an eddy behind the old stone pier carried floating objects backward; together they revised their plan rather than repeating the mistake.
With the visiting readers watching, they retrieved the parcel from the eddy and marked the hazard for boaters, then explained the clue so their neighbors could prevent the problem next time.

title: The Clock That Struck Thirteen

resolution: replaced the spring and counted twelve clear strikes

title: The Bubbles Beneath the Pond
central_conflict: bubbles rose beside the village pond every morning
decisive_choice: a buried irrigation pipe leaked air when its pump started
resolution: repaired the pipe joint and restored the pond bank
story_beats: At the snowy meadow, rabbit and fox discovered bubbles rose beside the village pond every morning before the library opened, leaving the visiting readers waiting.
Rabbit attempted an immediate fix, but they searched for trapped fish but found none; fox stopped the attempt before the situation worsened.
Fox examined the evidence and realized a buried irrigation pipe leaked air when its pump started; together they revised their plan rather than repeating the mistake.
With the visiting readers watching, they repaired the pipe joint and restored the pond bank, then explained the clue so their neighbors could prevent the problem next time.
